name: SikaRoof VersiJack Vertical Paver Clips
paste:
SIKAROOF® VERSIJACK® VERTICAL PAVER CLIPS: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Vertical Paver Clips, May 2026, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sikaroof-versijackverticalpaverclips.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaRoof® VersiJack® Vertical Paver Clips where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2026, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description.
    - SikaRoof® VersiJack® Vertical Paver Clips is an accessory used to hold a 20 mm thick paver horizontally to construct the raised flooring fascia. Vertical edge clips are manufactured from aluminium, and this clip holds the the top of the fascia paver at the finished paver layer.
    - SikaRoof® VersiJack® Vertical Paver Clips is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiJack® and SikaRoof® VersiJack® Vertical Paver Clips Base and is installed between the top of pedestals and beneath the pavers.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Vertical edge clip for raised paving installations on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaRoof® VersiJack® Vertical Paver Clips
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: VERTICAL EDGE CLIP FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED FLOORING
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (May 2026, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Creates a fascia around raised flooring
    - Holds 20 mm thick paver
    - Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
    - Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Silver flat clip
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Dimensions: 242 x 45 x 33 mm
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Vertical Paver Clips Top; Refer to pricelist
    - Shelf life: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet.
    - Storage conditions: Product must be stored in their original packing, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (May 2026, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 Application. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (May 2026, Version 01.01) states no application requirements.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (May 2026, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Vertical Paver Clips, May 2026, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sikaroof-versijackverticalpaverclips.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
